title: Match Social Studies Words
instruction: Tap a word on the left, then tap its meaning on the right!
hint: Start with the pairs you know! Blue is water, 2D is flat, 3D is not flat, and 2 is Egypt!

items.explanation: 3D = not flat, 2D = flat like paper, spherical = shaped like a ball, portable = easy to carry!

pairs: Tells what colors and symbols mean
items.explanation: Borders separate countries, a map key explains symbols, a road map shows streets, and portable means easy to carry.
Blue = water, yellow = deserts, green = land, and borders = lines between countries!
On the Northern Africa map: 1 is Sudan, 2 is Egypt, 3 is Libya, and 4 is Tunisia!
On the Northern Africa map: 3 is Libya, 4 is Tunisia, 5 is Algeria, and 6 is Morocco!
